notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) got robots.txt and homepage 200 OK but page is client-rendered (React/PWA shell, no nav/product data in raw HTML) so escalated. Tier (b) Playwright headless was blocked with an Akamai 'Access Denied' page on garnethill.com; escalated to Playwright headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled + a standard desktop Chrome UA, which loaded successfully for every page used in this extraction (tier c / Claude-in-Chrome not needed). robots.txt has no Claude-bot disallow-all (only disallows checkout/account/search-service paths), so no tier-specific block applied. TREE: union of the rendered top-level mega-menu (nav[aria-label='Main menu'], the 'Bedding & Home' flyout panel with its Bedding/Bath/Home Decor/Rugs column groups) and the XML category sitemap (robots.txt Sitemap: SiteMapIndex_v2.xml -> SiteMap_CAT_001-004_v2.xml, 131 category URLs). The sitemap contained no URLs outside the mega-menu's own list under /bedding-home/ - confirms the tree is complete, no hidden/orphan categories. Site has no dedicated Storage/Organization nav entry, group, or sitemap URL anywhere (checked case-insensitive for storage/organiz/basket/bin across all 131 sitemap URLs and the full rendered nav HTML - zero matches), consistent with Garnet Hill being a bedding/linens/apparel specialty retailer with no home-organization line. QTY: each leaf category page was opened in the same Playwright browser session and the qty was read from the rendered '<N> Items' text in the page's own total-number-of-products element (e.g. class="total-number-of-products" -> "71 Items" on the Sheets page); h1 and <link rel=canonical> were checked against the requested URL on every leaf to rule out a silently-wrong-number slug. EXCLUDED (neither array): 'All Bedding'/'All Bath'/'All Home Decor'/'All Rugs' (View-All / ?index=2 listing links), 'Features' and 'Collections' sub-columns (promotional/seasonal landing pages e.g. Top-Rated Home, Fall Decor Shop, The Linen Shop, The Dorm Shop, The Flannel Shop, Monogram Shop, Kids' Bedding, Get the Look), 'Furniture' (/bedding-home/decor/furniture/ - Furniture task, already validated), 'Lighting' (/bedding-home/decor/lighting/ - Lighting task, already validated), 'Decorative Accessories' (/bedding-home/decor/decorative-accessories/ - Decorative Home Accessories task, already validated), the 'New Arrivals', 'Clothing', 'Shoes & Accessories', 'Linen' (material cross-collection), and 'Sale' top-nav menus (apparel/fashion/cross-category promo, out of scope), '50th Anniversary'/'Fall Preview'/'Editors' Picks' secondary-nav promo links. 'Throws' (/bedding-home/decor/throws/, 25 items) and 'Blankets & Throws' (/bedding-home/bedding/blankets-throws/, 34 items) are two genuinely distinct listing URLs with different item counts and different h1s reached via different nav paths (Home Decor group vs Bedding group) - both kept per the duplicate rule (different URLs = keep separately, not a duplicate). Grouping rows preserve the site's own nesting: 'Bedding & Home' (top nav) > Bedding / Bath / Home Decor / Rugs (flyout column headers) > leaf subcategories. The 'Home Decor' group row is retained despite dropping Furniture/Lighting/Decorative Accessories because it still has 2 qualifying Textile leaves (Pillow Covers, Throws).
